programme_goal: Determine when JEPA representations carry decision-relevant information for navigation beyond kinematic prediction, reactive control and explicit memory. Start with a validated testbed, then E1, then moving obstacles.
current_goal: Establish a validated Go2 simulation navigation testbed; determine C0-C4 capability for paired unseen-maze beacon retrieval and return, report the preregistered capability criterion, produce example videos and an E1 proposal, then stop.
